::: {#exm-replication}
#### A replication of the normal data-generating process

<!-- no-figure: the example describes the steps of one replication -->

For the [normal data-generating process](#exm-data-generating-process),
one [replication](#def-replication) draws $n = 10$ values from the normal distribution with expectation $0$ and variance $4$.
It then computes the [estimate](estimation.qmd#def-estimate) $T_m$ of the variance $\varpar$ from those 10 values.
A second replication draws 10 new values, independently of the first, and computes $T_{m + 1}$.
:::
